#!/bin/bash


# export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nvidia/cublas/lib:/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nvidia/cudnn/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
source .venv/bin/activate

if [ "$1" == "start" ]; then
  if [ -z "$HF_TOKEN" ]; then
    echo "Need a valid huggingface token passed by environment variable HF_TOKEN.";
    exit 1;
  fi

  if [ ! -f "/models/.initialized" ] || [ ! -f "/models/diarization.generated.yaml" ]; then
    # load necessary models
    huggingface-cli login --token $HF_TOKEN
    # TODO check if login was successful
    python -m shared.model_download required-models.txt -gr
    mv /app/diarization.generated.yaml /models/
    touch /models/.initialized
  fi

  python -m asr_service
else
  echo "Command $@"
  exec "$@"
fi
